headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would lead the Department of Commerce if top leaders are unable to serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which Department of Commerce officials would step in to act as Secretary of Commerce if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. It is meant to keep the department running without a gap in leadership. No summary was provided, so details such as the exact list of officials are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are named, in a set order, to temporarily take on the Secretary's duties if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 18, 2001; exact effective date not stated in the source material.
